what: Dark-music firmware for the FM-1: 21 genres, 210 pieces, from dark techno to dark ambient and darkwave. Wander evolves it on its own. Arp with Hold, Dice, step editor. New in 1.0.5: brand new visuals, simplified settings, bigger easier-to-read text, plain-language help, SEL shortcut menu.
